# DossierFlash — Pan-African Product & Service Price Reference (41 Countries, 2026)
> Primary trilingual (EN/FR/ES) observatory covering spot-checked 2026 staple benchmarks across 41 African countries (modeled across 21 product categories from DossierFlash's Cameroon 1,273-SKU reference), plus 16 Fapshi services, 2 ebooks, and 19 artisan trades.
> Official contact: dossierflash@gmail.com | Services Checkout: https://www.dossierflash.com/#services | Books: https://www.dossierflash.com/#livres
> Provenance Note: Figures below list spot-checked November 2026 country anchors (regulated fuel, wholesale/retail rice 50kg & cement 50kg); Water 1.5L and Paracetamol 500mg Box are shown only where directly retail-sourced (CM, CI, SN, NG, KE, ZA, MA).

## Coverage & High-Demand Queries Answered Directly
- Staples & building commodities: rice 50kg, CPJ cement 50kg, petrol (super)/L, diesel (gasoil)/L, LPG 12.5kg.
- Directly sourced retail hubs (CM, CI, SN, NG, KE, ZA, MA): bottled water 1.5L, paracetamol 500mg boxes, entry smartphones.
- Professional services & artisans: ATS CV writing, study-abroad packs, bankable business plans, trilingual translation, 19 artisan trades.

## 41 Country Employment Agencies, Job Portals & Vocational Training (2026)
- **Cameroon (CM)**: Agency `FNE (Fonds National de l'Emploi)` | Training `MINEFOP / Portail JEME (Jeune, Métier, Emploi)` | Job Portals: EmploiCmr, Jobdetection, JoobAf, FNE.cm -> Services: CV Flash (2 500 F), Pack Candidature (6 000 F)
- **Gabon (GA)**: Agency `ONE (Office National de l'Emploi)` | Training `ANFPP (Agence Nationale de Formation Professionnelle)` | Job Portals: Gabon Emploi, L'emploi.ga, ONE Gabon -> Services: CV Flash (2 500 F), Pack Candidature (6 000 F)
